process_defect_found_and_corrected.scope_check: finder.py was the only production module whose committed content differed from the working tree, and no other module under solvent/ contains a mutant pattern. The working tree was never wrong, only the snapshot of it.
process_defect_found_and_corrected.cause: a mutation run owns the source files it patches for as long as it runs; nothing may be committed from the tree underneath it.
